title: UAT library register: synthetic pump fire
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

entries.title: Return to service without a leak test
entries.lesson: When a joint is disturbed, a leak test before restart is the barrier, and a checklist holds it.
entries.context: At Kestrel Works the pump went back into service on 2024-03-20 at 03:12 after a seal change, with no leak test recorded.

tier_messages.T1: Do not restart without the leak-test record.

recommendations.what: Block restart until a signed leak-test record is attached
recommendations.leading_indicator: Share of restarts with a leak-test record

entries.title: Seals without a specification
entries.lesson: Spares bought without a specification weaken every joint they go into.
entries.context: Seals were bought locally without a specification.

tier_messages.T3: Stock only seals that match the specification.

recommendations.what: Stock only specification-approved seals, so a local substitute cannot be issued
recommendations.leading_indicator: Share of seal issues that match the specification
